subject: Digital Signal Processing

questions.markdown:
Using frequency sampling method, determine the coefficients of a linear phase FIR filter of length $M=11$, which has a symmetric unit sample response and a frequency response that satisfies the conditions

$$
\alpha = 0, \quad \text{and} \quad H_r\left(\frac{2\pi k}{11}\right)=
\begin{cases}
1, & k=0,1, \\
0.4, & k=2 \\
0, & k=3,4,5
\end{cases}
$$
Obtain the lattice structure for the system $H(z)=1+0.2z^{-1}+0.45z^{-2}-0.7z^{-3}$.

Determine the system function of a causal LTI system, with zeros at $z=0.75$ and $z=0.5$, and a complex pair of poles at $z=1.5e^{j\pi/8}$. State whether the system is stable and justify your answer, with the help of a pole-zero plot.
Develop radix-2 DIF FFT algorithm. Sketch the signal flow diagram for $N=8$. Use this concept to find the DFT of the given 8-point sequence $x(n)=[1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2]$.

Consider the finite duration signals $x_1[n]$ and $x_2[n]$ with $N$-point DFTs $X_1[k]$ and $X_2[k]$ respectively. Show that $\mathrm{IDFT}\{X_1[k]X_2[k]\}$ is equal to the circular convolution between $x_1[n]$ and $x_2[n]$.

If $X[k]$ is the $N$-point DFT of finite duration noise sequence $x[n]$, determine the $N$-point DFT of the sequence

$$
x_s[n]=x[n]\sin\left(\frac{2\pi k_0 n}{N}\right), \qquad 0\le n\le N-1
$$

Specification of desired low-pass filter frequency response is given by

$$
\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \le |H(e^{j\omega})| \le 1, \qquad 0\le \omega \le 0.2\pi
$$

$$
|H(e^{j\omega})|\le 0.08, \qquad 0.4\pi \le \omega \le \pi
$$

Determine the order and poles of Butterworth filter required to meet the above filter specification. Use bilinear transformation. Assume sampling interval of $T=2$ sec.
For the filter specification given in Question 3A, determine analog system function $H_a(s)$ and use bilinear transformation to obtain $H(z)$ of Butterworth digital filter.
Determine $X(0)$ for sequence $x(n)=\{1,2,3,4\}$ using Geortzel algorithm for $N=4$.

Convert the analog filter to its equivalent digital filter whose system function is given by

$$
H(s)=\frac{s+0.2}{s^2+0.4s+16.04}
$$

using impulse invariance technique. Assume sampling frequency of 1Hz

Obtain the direct-form II realization for the system

$$
H(z)=\frac{2(1-z^{-1})(1+z^{-1}+2z^{-2})}{(1+0.2z^{-1})(1-0.2z^{-1}+0.8z^{-2})}
$$

Describe with mathematical expressions the Welch method of power spectrum estimation. List the performance metrics of power spectrum estimation techniques. List the advantages of non-parametric methods of power spectrum estimation.

Realize an efficient direct form structure of the linear phase FIR filter whose system function is

$$
H(z)=0.015-0.145z^{-1}+0.268z^{-2}-0.268z^{-3}+0.145z^{-4}-0.015z^{-5}
$$

Determine the corresponding input-output equation.
For the filter given in Question 5B, write the equations for the magnitude response and phase response. Is this filter suitable for the design of a lowpass filter? Justify your answer.
